title: SSH Security
description: Replace Telnet with encrypted SSH for secure remote management.
scenario: Replace Telnet with encrypted SSH for secure remote management.

concepts.title: SSH vs Telnet
concepts.body: Telnet sends everything — including passwords — in plaintext. SSH encrypts the entire session. Never manage devices over Telnet.
concepts.code:
Telnet: plaintext — sniffable
SSH:    encrypted — secure

concepts.title: RSA Keys
concepts.body: SSH needs an RSA keypair. The hostname + domain name form the key name, so set those first. Use at least a 1024-bit modulus.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# ip domain-name ccna.lab
SW1(config)# crypto key generate rsa
  modulus 1024

concepts.title: Restrict VTY to SSH
concepts.body: "transport input ssh" on the VTY lines blocks Telnet completely — only SSH sessions are accepted.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# line vty 0 4
SW1(config-line)# transport input ssh
SW1(config-line)# login local
